levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الاشعري
محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الاشعري

notes: «أو عن رجل عنه» is an alternative route for the same saying: a man who narrates from Abu Sulayman. It is written as a variant group (rule 4), not as a second route; «عنه» points back to Abu Sulayman.
«23-2» is the report number and is left out; «وأحمد بن إدريس جميعا» makes the two co-transmitters meet at the next name.
